title: Listwise calibration pipeline and NDCG/MRR telemetry hooks for customer prompt-set experiments
creator: Maya Chen
description: Build a reproducible listwise calibration and evaluation pipeline that instruments NDCG and MRR per-customer prompt-set and attaches A/B hooks so product experiments can compare reranker variants under realistic traffic. This ticket covers: (1) sampling and stratification of customer prompt-sets and query types, (2) offline listwise eval runner that supports k-fold and time-split evaluation, (3) telemetry hooks to emit per-request ranking labels and metrics to the Console, (4) lightweight online experiment A/B guardrails (treatment assignment IDs, sample rates, fallbacks), and (5) calibration utilities to convert ranking scores to comparable confidences across model variants.
acceptance_criteria: Offline evaluation runner produces NDCG@10 and MRR@10 per-customer prompt-set and overall aggregated slices
Evaluation outputs include confidence intervals (bootstrap) and stratified-aware metrics for at least 5 customer segments
Console dashboard shows NDCG/MRR timeseries by model variant and by customer slice with drift alerts configured
A/B hooks implemented in rerank endpoint: deterministic assignment key, sample rate override, and automatic fallback to control on errors
Calibration tool produces mapping artifacts that can be loaded at inference time to normalize score distributions between quantized and FP models
implementation_plan: Phase 1: Data ingestion - add prompt-set tagging and provenance fields to incoming evaluation bundles (S3 bucket + manifest schema)
Phase 2: Offline runner - extend eval harness to support listwise metrics, k-fold shuffling, temporal holdout, and bootstrap CI
Phase 3: Telemetry - add NDCG/MRR compute in eval runner and emit per-request and aggregated metrics to metrics backend (Prometheus -> Console ETL)
Phase 4: Online hooks - add deterministic assignment and sample rate to rerank service; wire experiment metadata into request logs and traces
Phase 5: Calibration - implement isotonic/regression-based mapper and integrate loader in serving runtime for on-the-fly score normalization
Phase 6: Dashboards & alerts - create Console views for per-variant NDCG/MRR and set up drift/regression alerting rules
updates: 2025-02-14: Ticket created after spike with Product on need for per-customer NDCG tracking for upcoming Enterprise pilot.

2025-02-19: Spike complete — evaluated existing eval harness; listwise implementation will reuse candidate-provenance middleware from ENG-90742 (ref PR #3867). Decision: extend current harness rather than build from scratch.
2025-02-25: Design review with PM/Product Analytics — agreed on stratification keys: customer_id, traffic_tier, query_intent (search/answer/chat), and session_length bucket.
2025-03-02: Prototype offline runner emitted NDCG@10 and MRR@10 for synthetic prompt-sets (see run artifacts). Confirmed bootstrap CI approach with 1000 resamples is stable for small prompt-sets.
2025-03-07: Telemetry schema PR opened (github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pulls/4122). Telemetry will be emitted as: metric.ndcg10, metric.mrr10, tags: {model_variant, customer_id, slice}.

2025-03-10: Initial A/B assignment library landed in feature branch (github.com/redwood-inference/rerank-service/pulls/88). Implementation uses XXHash(customer_id + experiment_key) mod 10000 to derive deterministic bucket. Integration tests added.
decisions: Reuse existing eval harness and candidate-provenance instrumentation to minimize risk and ensure continuity with previous rerank experiments.
Adopt listwise NDCG formulation with tie-breaking by original rank and compute MRR for complementary signal.
Emit both per-request metrics (for traceability) and aggregated rollups to Console; raw per-request emits are sampled at 10% to limit cost with full aggregations derived from offline runs.
Use bootstrap for CI and isotonic regression for calibration mapping because it handles non-monotonicities observed in quantized score distributions.
A/B assignment will be deterministic, per-customer, and support per-customer overrides for enterprise pilots via admin console.
Fallback semantics: on any runtime error in treatment path, fall back to control variant and emit 'experiment.fallback' event for post-mortem.
Stratified sampling will prioritize underrepresented prompt-sets (long-tail customers) to ensure signal for enterprise customers; oversampling will be recorded via weight tags.
risks: Small prompt-sets yield unstable NDCG estimates — mitigated by bootstrap CIs and per-slice minimum sample thresholds
Telemetry emission costs — mitigate via sampling and aggregate-only modes for high-volume customers
Calibration drift when models are rolled frequently — require calibration artifact refresh policy tied to model deployment cadence
Experiment leakage if assignment keys change — require strict immutability and migration tooling for assignment keys
testing_plan: Unit tests for listwise NDCG implementation and MRR on known toy datasets
Integration test: end-to-end eval pipeline running on synthetic corpus with expected metrics asserted
Load test: exercise telemetry emission at 2x expected pilot traffic with sampling enabled to validate cost and performance
Canary rollout for A/B hooks on staging followed by staggered production rollouts with circuit breaker (fail-open to control)
Verify Console dashboards ingest and display metrics correctly and alerts trigger on synthetic regressions
